notes.title: New Game Release: Rebound Express
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42325239/b5ac966d084078460394b37429b4f5b5488042c9.png[/img]
Hey everyone,

I'm excited to share something new I’ve been working on — a small side project that came out of a one-week game jam:
Rebound Express — a fast-paced 2D physics puzzle game about delivering bouncing boxes with speed and style.

It plays like building your own Rube Goldberg machine: you set up platforms, ramps, and rebound pads to guide parcels to their destination as efficiently as possible.
Each level is short, snappy, and designed for quick retries and high-score chases. It also features online leaderboards if you're into optimizing runs and flexing your engineering precision.

It’s light, casual, and fun, and if you enjoyed AV-Racer, I’d really appreciate the support if you grabbed a copy when it drops.

Launching next month! wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3729350/Rebound_Express/

Thanks and all the love,
– Wassim

notes.title: Update 1.3.50: New best lap records board
notes.notes:
As requested by players, the game now has a records board with the best lap times in every track and in each car class, acessible from the main menu.

The records are universal across all saves and outside of career, except for split screen mode. Anytime you run a faster lap on a track the board gets updated.

Thank you very much for playing AV-Racer, if there is any issues, please report them.
Now show us what is your best time!

-Wassim

notes.title: 1.3.44 Small career and difficulty patch
notes.notes:
Shortened number of laps in career championships a bit. Most tracks in career are one lap shorter. In the World Championship they're 10 laps a race instead of 12. 
Some users also find the game too difficult so I reduced the "Very Easy" difficulty further. This should not affect the rest of the difficulties.

-Wassim
